rca_of_issue: No scoped server or standalone-page delivery defect reproduced. Initial test assumptions were corrected, not product code: public edge omits GET Content-Length while delivering complete chunked bytes (HEAD has correct length); edge injects Cloudflare beacon/challenge scripts, blocked by default-src none. App template has no scripts and public document has no Expo/auth routing. Browser net::ERR_ABORTED on ZIP navigation is normal download handoff; expect_download completed, correct bytes/hash and unchanged page proved success. The actual user's chat/device interception cause remains unproven.
